text:
Ava (Marketing): Quick ask — can someone spin up a 1‑page 'Operational Slate' for enterprise prospects that focuses on security + SLA-backed deployment modes? Need: 1) single PDF one-pager, 2) 2‑line benchmark narrative for sales + webinar, 3) short webinar promo copy + CTA, 4) inbound routing tags/mapping. Goal: field-ready asset for demos. Deadline: EOD Thu.

Priya (Content): On it. Audience callout: SRE/platform leads + CISO. Tone: concise, outcome + risk-reduction forward. I'll draft two layouts (technical + exec). Any mandatory regulatory callouts?

Sam (ProductMarketing): Include the new benchmark framing: p99 latency delta (Dedicated ~120ms vs Hosted median ~220ms) and operational unit-cost guidance (ballpark $X vs $Y per 1k tokens). Keep numbers high-level and label as "example results" so we can update post-qa.

Diego (Field): Add a 3-row decision table: "When to use Hosted / Dedicated / Private" with 1-line rationale each (speed, predictability, compliance). Also add a tiny checklist: network, KMS, audit log requirements.

Jules (Sales Ops): Routing matrix suggestion: tag:enterprise_sla -> enterprise-sales@redwood.com; tag:private_deploy -> solutions-eng@redwood.com; tag:gov_compliance -> gov-sales@redwood.com. Also recommend setting priority=high for any lead mentioning SLA or SOC2/HIPAA in the first inquiry.

Priya (Content): Drafting headline options and subject lines. Quick subject candidates:
```
1) Secure, SLA-backed inference for production teams — 1‑pager
2) How to choose Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for secure inference
3) Operational Slate: security + SLAs for inference (1 page)
```
Which angle do we prefer? Exec (1) or decision-driven (2)?

Ava (Marketing): Decision-driven (2) — keep it actionable. Also include an immediate CTA: "Schedule a 20‑min field call" + calendar link. Webinar tie-in: a 30‑min session — 20m demo + 10m customer panel. Promo cadence: blog post, 2x LinkedIn posts, email to trial users, partner co-promos.

Sam (ProductMarketing): For the benchmark two-liner for sales copy, propose: "Real-world eval: Dedicated capacity delivered ~45% lower p99 latency vs Hosted for interactive workloads while enabling predictable unit costs — ideal when sub-200ms p99 and strict SLAs matter." Short and punchy.

Diego (Field): I'll draft the decision table copy. Also propose two lightning callouts for the one-pager: "KMS/HSM integrations" and "Audit trail + evidence for compliance reviews" — both 1 sentence.

Priya (Content): Working on the PDF layout now. Will include: hero stat, 3-box decision table, benchmark 2‑liner, short customer quote placeholder, routing + CTA. Uploading draft in ~3h: https://drive.redwood/workspace/operational-slate-drafts

Jules (Sales Ops): For inbound automation, recommend the following Slack map (for ops):
```
if lead.tags contains "SLA" or "compliance" -> notify #enterprise-sales, DM @SalesLead
if lead.tags contains "private_deploy" -> create ticket for SolutionsEng queue
if lead.mrr >= 10k -> add priority tag and assign AE directly
```
Also add a field to HubSpot: "deploy_preference" with enums {hosted,dedicated,private}.

launch-bot: Asset created: /shared/drive/operational-slate-v0.1.pdf (editable).

Priya (Content): Uploaded a first-pass PDF to the drive link. Need a hero stat and one small customer example (field: finance startup — anonymized) to make it concrete.

Diego (Field): I can provide the anonymized quote and a short ROI bullet (reduced inference costs by ~30% after switching to Dedicated + batching) — will post in the drive.

Sam (ProductMarketing): Small edit to the benchmark line: replace "~45%" with "example observed delta — varies by model/profile" to be safe for public docs.

Ava (Marketing): Perfect. Priya — wrap edits and finalize PDF by EOD. Diego/Jules/Sam — review for technical accuracy and routing. We'll queue the asset for the webinar promo next week. Thanks team! :rocket:
